mapper.sql: id, evidence_id, user_id, evidence_type, source_module, source_type, source_id, skill_key, summary_json, quality_level, observed_at, valid_from, valid_to, content_hash, projector_version, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO growth_evidence ( evidence_id, user_id, evidence_type, source_module, source_type, source_id, skill_key, summary_json, quality_level, observed_at, valid_from, valid_to, content_hash, projector_version, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{evidenceId}, #{userId}, #{evidenceType}, #{sourceModule}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{skillKey}, #{summaryJson}, #{qualityLevel}, #{observedAt}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{contentHash}, #{projectorVersion}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE evidence_id = VALUES(evidence_id), skill_key = VALUES(skill_key), summary_json = VALUES(summary_json), quality_level = VALUES(quality_level), observed_at = VALUES(observed_at), valid_from = VALUES(valid_from), valid_to = NULL, content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM growth_evidence WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND valid_from <= NOW() AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > NOW()) ORDER BY observed_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
